look.aboutModalContent:
Welcome to the **MMGIS Reference Mission**.

This mission demonstrates the full capabilities of the Multi-Mission Geographic Information System.

sublayers.name: Hotline Gradient Path
sublayers.description: Traverse from Golden Gate Bridge to Oakland with gradient visualization. Use the layer dropdown in the Layers Tool to switch between elevation (m), speed (m/s), and roll (degrees) gradient visualization.

sublayers.name: Hotline Gradient 3D
sublayers.description: 3D gradient polyline demonstration with elevation-based positioning in the Cesium globe. Routes with varied elevation values (50-2000m) colored by elevation, speed, or roll.

sublayers.name: Geodatasets
Geodatasets - Basic
sublayers.description: Demonstrates the simplest geodataset layer: sourceType='geodatasets' routes to the PostGIS-backed geodatasets API instead of a static file.

sublayers.name: Geodatasets - Dynamic Extent
sublayers.description: Demonstrates dynamicExtent: only features within the current map viewport are queried from the database. Pan or zoom to trigger a re-query. dynamicExtentMoveThreshold='500/z' throttles re-queries to 500m of pan at zoom 0, scaled by zoom level.

sublayers.name: Geodatasets - No Duplicates
sublayers.description: Demonstrates noDuplicates: the geodataset has multiple records per location sharing a group_id (site_id). With noDuplicates=true, only one feature per group is rendered using DISTINCT ON (group_id). The dataset has 8 records at 4 locations — only 4 points appear on the map.

sublayers.name: Geodatasets - Properties on Click
sublayers.description: Demonstrates getFeaturePropertiesOnClick: the initial map load fetches only geometry and feature IDs (feature_code). Full properties (address, area, visitor stats, etc.) are fetched from the database only when a feature is clicked, reducing initial load size.

sublayers.name: Geodatasets - Time Series
sublayers.description: Demonstrates time.type='requery' for geodatasets: the time range is sent to PostGIS as a server-side SQL filter on the start_time/end_time BIGINT columns. Use the Time Control tool to filter events by date range (Jan–Jun 2024).
PostGIS-backed vector layers showcasing geodataset features: dynamic viewport querying, deduplication, lazy property loading, and server-side time filtering.

sublayers.name: Mosaic - Transmitter
sublayers.description: Rover waypoint for Sol 1051. Click to open the 360° Navcam panoramic mosaic. The Mosaic Targets layer must be enabled to see target dots overlaid on the sphere.

sublayers.name: Mosaic - Receivers
sublayers.description: Named rock targets observed from Sol 1051. Enable this layer alongside Photosphere Waypoint to see target positions overlaid on the panoramic mosaic sphere.

sublayers.name: Zoom - Layer Config (10-14)
sublayers.description: Mixed geometry types (points, lines, polygons, arrows, labels) with zoom controlled by layer-level minZoom/maxZoom config. Visible at zoom 10-14.

sublayers.name: Zoom - Feature Properties
sublayers.description: Mixed geometry types with per-feature zoom control via properties.style.minZoom and properties.style.maxZoom. Different features appear at different zoom levels (8-20). Zoom in/out to see features appear/disappear individually.

sublayers.name: Tags and Description
sublayers.description: This layer demonstrates the layer description and tags features. Tags help organize and filter layers.

sublayers.name: Attachment - Image (Per-Feature)
sublayers.description: Demonstrates per-feature image URLs using pathProp. Each marker has its own image (Perseverance and Curiosity rovers). Images always visible, no rotation.

sublayers.name: Attachment - Image (Shared + Rotation)
sublayers.description: Demonstrates shared base path image URL. All markers use the same image but with different rotations via angleProp (heading). Click markers to view images.

sublayers.name: Elevation - RdYlBu (COG/NPY)
sublayers.description:
USGS 1/3 arc-second DEM for the San Francisco Bay area via TiTiler (.npy — raw float32). **Alt+1** to toggle.

**Ramp 0:** RdYlBu diverging — cold blues low, warm reds high.
**Ramp 1:** Earth tones terrain palette.

sublayers.name: Elevation - Terrarium (COG)
sublayers.description:
Mapzen **Terrarium**-encoded PNG tiles — ~10–50 KB/tile vs ~256 KB for .npy; much faster network transfer with ~1 cm precision. No-data (−32768) renders transparent.

**Ramp 0:** Plasma · **Ramp 1:** Viridis

sublayers.name: Elevation - TerrainRGB (COG)
sublayers.description:
Mapbox **TerrainRGB**-encoded PNG tiles — ~0.1 m elevation precision. This layer is **controlled** (programmatic visibility) and starts at **80% opacity** for basemap blending.

**Ramp:** Magma — black to pale yellow.

sublayers.name: Elevation - TerrainRGB (COG) Image
sublayers.description:
Mapbox **TerrainRGB**-encoded PNG tiles — ~0.1 m elevation precision. This layer is **controlled** (programmatic visibility) and starts at **80% opacity** for basemap blending.

**Ramp:** Magma — black to pale yellow.

sublayers.name: Elevation - Grayscale (COG)
sublayers.description: Grayscale elevation overlay at **70% opacity** — useful for compositing over imagery. **Ramp 0:** black = low, white = high. **Ramp 1:** inverted (white = low, black = high) for relief-shading composites.

sublayers.name: Elevation - Transparent Overlay
sublayers.description: Demonstrates **transparent ramp stops**: the two lowest stops are transparent, so only mid-to-high elevations are colored (yellow → orange → red). The basemap shows through at low altitudes. Initial opacity 50% for blending.

sublayers.name: Elevation - 13-Stop Rainbow
sublayers.description: Showcases the **maximum 13-stop** color ramp with a full spectral rainbow. Uses `sigfigs: 2` for high-precision legend labels and provides a **Download URL** so users can retrieve the source GeoTIFF from the Layers tool menu.

sublayers.name: Elevation - STAC Multi-Ramp (STAC/RGB)
sublayers.description:
**STAC collection** source (`reference_mission_USGS_SF_DEM`) via titiler-pgstac. Showcases 4 selectable ramps in the Layers tool. **Alt+3** to toggle.

**Ramp 0:** Spectral (11-stop diverging)
**Ramp 1:** Inferno (6-stop)
**Ramp 2:** Earth Tones (9-stop)
**Ramp 3:** RdPu (7-stop purple)

sublayers.name: Elevation - STAC Terrarium (STAC)
sublayers.description: **STAC + Terrarium** combination: COG mosaic from titiler-pgstac served as compact Terrarium PNG tiles. Combines STAC multi-item mosaic benefits with bandwidth savings (~10–50 KB/tile). No-data (−32768) renders transparent. **Ramp:** Viridis.

sublayers.name: Elevation - RGBA Tiles (URL)
sublayers.description: RGBA-encoded float32 PNG tiles generated by gdal2customtiles.py --dem. Tests the plain URL source type for Data Layers.

sublayers.name: EMIT Methane Mosaicked
sublayers.description: EMIT L2B Methane Enhancement Data 60 m V002 - STAC COG collection. Requires WITH_STAC=true and WITH_TITILER_PGSTAC=true.

sublayers.name: USGS SF DEM — Elevation
sublayers.description: USGS 1/3 arc-second DEM for San Francisco Bay area, terrain colormap. Requires WITH_STAC=true and WITH_TITILER_PGSTAC=true.

sublayers.name: USGS SF DEM — Grayscale
sublayers.description: USGS SF DEM grayscale — cogExpressionEditable enabled for expression editing demo. Requires WITH_STAC=true and WITH_TITILER_PGSTAC=true.
